label: S. 4730
title: Community College Agriculture Advancement Act of 2026

items.snippet: This bill allows the Department of Agriculture (USDA) to make competitive grants to assist eligible entities (i.e., a junior or community college, or a consortium…

…eligible entities (i.e., a junior or community college, or a consortium or alliance of two-year public colleges, supporting agriculture advancement) in maintaining and expanding their capacity to conduct workforce…
…with a local agriculture industry operator to provide experiential training and other opportunities for students.

items.item: Center of Excellence for Agriculture Advancement
items.snippet: An eligible entity may submit to USDA an application for designation and funding as a Center of Excellence for Agriculture Advancement.

lobbying.caption: From Senate lobbying disclosures (LD-2). A filing mentions this bill; it does not show what was asked for, which side the client took, or any contact with this member. Reported amounts cover the whole filing, not this bill alone.
lobbying.amount_note: Amounts are the income or expenses reported on the whole LD-2 filing, not money spent on this bill.

caption: This shows who the bill names and who lobbied on it. It does not show who gains or loses, and lobbying can be for or against a bill.

H000273.label: Overlap, not proof of influence.
H000273.caption: Money from this member's itemized individual donors (over $200) whose self-reported employer falls in an industry that also has a client lobbying on this bill. Correlation only; not a quid pro quo. Donors give to campaigns for many reasons, and a lobbying client may have opposed the bill.
H000273.note: None of the lobbying clients on this bill matched an industry rule, so there is nothing to compare.
